description: Generate a zero-knowledge share link for a vault file, to hand it to a human. The returned link is PUBLIC: ANYONE who has the link can open and read the file. The decryption key is in the URL fragment (#k=...) — BitAtlas never sees it and cannot read the file, but whoever you send the link to can. Confirm with the user before sharing anything sensitive. Requires BITATLAS_MASTER_KEY.

expires_in.description: How long the link stays live (default 7d)

max_downloads.description: Optional cap on total downloads before the link expires

name: bitatlas_share_file
